historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use to install a telecommunications facility of 3 panel antennas on the belfry, and associated equipment cabinets in the belfry and at the street level, of an existing church.
The property held an existing church.
The property held an existing two-story, 40-foot tall publicly-used structure known as the Lincoln Park Presbyterian Church.
The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization for a wireless telecommunications facility within the belfry of the existing Lincoln Park Presbyterian Church, with amendments.
